title: Run state
description: The recovery record for a single run. A fresh session pointed at runs/<target>/<run_id>/ must be able to resume from this file alone.

mode.description: source = review a cloned repo; web = live HTTP target. Determines which mapper/provisioner mode applies.

policy_checked.description: Spec section 5. Re-read per program before provisioner or any live phase. Recorded so a resumed run can tell whether it actually ran.

automation_allowed.description: unknown is not a pass. Anything but 'yes' must raise a blocked entry before live testing.

modules.description: Module name -> status. A module may only reach 'complete' when every operations.json entry carrying that module has an outcome (enforced by gate_module_complete.py).

blocked.description: Anything needing the user. Never guessed past, never silently retried.

needed_from_user.description: The exact thing required, specific enough to act on without re-reading the run.
